title: 第110章 离岸落鲸第109章 渡冥河
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
棺材在冥河的水面上轻轻晃动，像一片随波的浮木。
林江月闭着眼，后背贴着粗糙的棺底，感受着水流的牵引。
黑暗中，无寐的声音平稳地传来：
“灵魂会经过摆渡，走入轮回大殿，便获得重生。”
“这个重生之人，灵魂上带着一个标记，像一根线，牵着他从这一世连接到最初的那一世。
无论轮回多少次，这个锚点都不会消失。
掌控了锚点的人，便能找到他所有的前世。”
林江月的眉头微微蹙起。
朝着无寐声音的方向偏了偏头：“我不明白。你的意思是，他就像一棵树，树是他，果子也是他？”
话音刚落，无寐还未来得及回答。
棺材外，一阵激烈的搅水声忽然炸开。
有什么巨大的东西在水面下翻腾。
紧接着是一声低沉的嘶吼，另一个方向传来更为尖锐的鸣叫。
像是两只妖兽正在争夺什么猎物。
“这畜生先咬到的！”
“咬到不算，吞下去才算！”
两声不同的兽吼交织在一起，随后是牙齿撞击硬物的咔嚓声。
棺材被涌浪推得偏离了方向，微微倾斜，又缓缓回正。
约莫一个时辰之后。
水声渐渐远去，打斗声沉入河底，只剩下余波消退后的细微波澜。

无寐的声音重新响起，语气平静如初：“一棵树终其一生只结一颗种子。
老树枯败，新树落地，便是重生。
树是他，种子也是他。”
过了半晌，她开口道：“那棵树知道自己结出的种子落在何处吗？”
“大多数重生之人并不知道。”无寐的回答简短，“而我们要救的这个人，他一定会知道。”
林江月的目光在黑暗中微微闪动。
“糟了，有一个巨物朝我们这里涌来！”
无寐眉心发出一点光亮，片刻之后他脸色发白，心跳陡然升快。
棺材外突然安静了。
林江月能听到的只有自己的心跳，以及身旁无寐几不可闻的呼吸声。
然后棺材猛地一震。
一股巨大的力量从下方撞上来，棺材被整个顶出了水面，又重重落下。
不等林江月反应过来，棺材再次被向上掀起，这一回没有落下，它被什么东西衔住了。
林江月神识扫过四周。
“什么东西——那是——”
“走！快走！”
两声短促的呼喊之后，水花声迅速远去。
之前那两只争斗的妖兽，放弃了快到嘴的猎物，头也不回地逃走了。
紧接着又是一阵水流的激荡。
一种湿漉漉的、带着黏液的触感包裹住了棺材的外部，紧跟着是一阵天旋地转。

四周陷入了彻底的黑暗，比棺材内原本的黑暗更浓、更稠。
林江月的双手死死扣住棺材内壁的木板。
她能听到棺材外部传来一阵沉闷的轰鸣，像是什么巨大的东西在吞咽。
content_en:
The coffin swayed gently on the water of the Styx, like a piece of driftwood following the waves.
Lin Jiangyue closed her eyes and pressed her back against the rough bottom of the coffin, feeling the pull of the water.
In the darkness, Wumei's voice came steadily:
"The soul will pass through the ferry and enter the Hall of Reincarnation, and then be reborn."
"This reborn person carries a mark on his soul, like a thread that connects him from this life to the first one.
No matter how many times you reincarnate, this anchor point will never disappear.
A person who controls the anchor point can find all his past lives. "
Lin Jiangyue's brows frowned slightly.
He tilted his head in the direction of Wumei's voice: "I don't understand. You mean, he is like a tree, the tree is him, and the fruit is also him?"
As soon as he finished speaking, Wumei didn't have time to answer.
Outside the coffin, a fierce sound of stirring water suddenly exploded.
Something huge was churning beneath the surface.
This was followed by a low roar, and a sharper cry came from the other direction.
It's like two monster beasts are fighting for some prey.
"The beast bit him first!"
“It doesn’t count until you bite it, it counts only after you swallow it!”
Two different beast roars intertwined together, followed by the clicking sound of teeth hitting hard objects.
The coffin was pushed out of the direction by the surge, tilted slightly, and then slowly returned to the right position.
About an hour later.
The sound of the water gradually faded away, and the sound of fighting sank to the bottom of the river, leaving only the subtle ripples after the aftermath subsided.
Wumei's voice sounded again, his tone as calm as ever: "A tree only bears one seed in its entire life.
When old trees wither and die, new trees fall to the ground, which is rebirth.
The tree is Him and the seed is Him. "
After a while, she said, "Does that tree know where the seeds it produces fall?"
"Most reborn people don't know." Wumei answered briefly, "And the person we want to save will definitely know."
Lin Jiangyue's eyes flickered slightly in the darkness.
"Oops, there's a giant thing coming towards us!"
There was a little light between Wumei's brows, and after a moment his face turned pale and his heartbeat suddenly increased.
There was sudden silence outside the coffin.
All Lin Jiangyue could hear was her own heartbeat and the almost inaudible breathing beside her.
Then the coffin jerked.
A huge force hit from below, and the coffin was pushed out of the water, then fell heavily.
Before Lin Jiangyue could react, the coffin was lifted upward again. This time it didn't fall. It was held by something.
Lin Jiangyue's consciousness swept around.
"What—that is—"
"Let's go! Let's go!"
After two short shouts, the sound of water splash quickly faded away.
The two monster beasts that were fighting before gave up the prey that was close to their mouths and ran away without looking back.
Then there was another surge of water.
A wet, slimy feeling enveloped the outside of the coffin, followed by a whirlwind of movement.
The surroundings fell into complete darkness, thicker and thicker than the original darkness inside the coffin.
Lin Jiangyue's hands tightly grasped the wooden boards on the inner wall of the coffin.
She could hear a dull roar coming from outside the coffin, like something huge was swallowing.
